ITEM.PTXT: Various settings for the ETC system can be made on the navigation display.

ENTRY.PTXT: Switches the interrupt display when using the ETC system between "On" and "Off".
Switches the voice guidance during ETC system use between "On" and "Off".
Switches warnings such as for forgetting to insert the ETC card, given approximately 20 seconds after ACC or IG ON, between "On" and "Off".
Warning Voice Guidance at ACC ON
Switches voice guidance warnings such as for forgetting to insert the ETC card, given approximately 20 seconds after ACC or IG ON, between "On" and "Off".
Switches the warning for forgetting to remove the card when the power is turned OFF between "On" and "Off".
